reviews.text: work great at fading dark spots and at protecting pimples
reviews.zh: 淡化黑斑同保護痘痘都好有效。

reviews.text: Bought for my teenager. Try many different brands. This one is the most effective and invisible. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 買俾我個十幾歲嘅孩子用。試過好多唔同品牌，呢款係最有效同最唔易見嘅。非常推薦。

reviews.text: I have tried pretty much all the pimple patches out there, and this one is truly the best!!! It takes out the junk even out of very deep acne and it really helps with healing.
reviews.zh: 我試過幾乎所有痘痘貼，呢款真係最好！！！連好深層嘅痘痘都可以吸出污物，真係幫到康復。

reviews.text: Son perfectos, cubren bien, no se ven y actúan rápido
reviews.zh: 佢哋好完美，遮得好好，睇唔到，而且好快見效。

reviews.text: Works the best when the pimple has come up and has a white head.
reviews.zh: 痘痘已經冒出、有白頭嗰陣，效果最好。

reviews.text: It’s good for sensitive and blemish skin, the texture is good, convenient and thin,
reviews.zh: 啱敏感同痘痘肌用，質地好，方便又薄，

reviews.text: Not really effective and made my skin itchy and irritated.
reviews.zh: 效果唔算好，仲令我皮膚發癢同刺激。

reviews.text: Stick to skin very well but does not appear invisible.
reviews.zh: 貼得好穩，但睇落唔算隱形。
